details: A consortium of firms including Ondo Finance, Mastercard, and JPMorgan successfully completed a pilot program to connect Ripple's XRP Ledger (XRPL) to global banking infrastructure. This initiative enabled the near real-time, cross-border settlement of tokenized U.S. Treasury bills, aiming to facilitate 24/7 global financial markets.
title: Ripple's XRPL Integrates with Global Banking for Tokenized Treasuries

details: U.S.-listed spot Bitcoin (BTC) Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded their first net outflows in May on May 8, totaling $277.5 million, thereby ending a five-day streak of inflows. This reversal was led by significant redemptions from funds managed by Fidelity and BlackRock, coinciding with Bitcoin's price falling below the key $80,000 level amid increased market volatility and geopolitical tensions.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See First May Outflows as BTC Dips Below $80K

details: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index declined to 38 on May 8, moving firmly into the "Fear" territory. This shift in market sentiment reflects broader caution among investors as Bitcoin's price dropped below $80,000 and other major cryptocurrencies also experienced declines. Macroeconomic headwinds and escalating geopolitical tensions are cited as contributing factors.
title: Crypto Fear & Greed Index Dips to 38, Signaling "Fear"

details: Coinbase announced a reduction of approximately 14% of its workforce, impacting around 700 employees. The cryptocurrency exchange cited a cyclical downturn in the crypto market and a strategic shift towards becoming an "AI-native" organization as reasons for the layoffs, aiming to reduce operating expenses and streamline operations.
title: Coinbase Cuts 14% of Workforce, Cites AI and Market Downturn

details: Whale inflows of XRP to Binance have reached their lowest point in four years, suggesting a significant reduction in selling pressure from large holders. Despite recent price fluctuations, data indicates growing institutional interest in XRP ETFs, with large buyers reportedly accumulating XRP off exchanges, contributing to a tightening supply.
title: XRP Whale Inflows to Binance Hit 4-Year Low Amid Accumulation

details: Ethereum (ETH) whales have reportedly accumulated $322 million worth of ETH within 96 hours, demonstrating strong buying interest. Staking demand for ETH is also significantly outpacing withdrawals. While some analysts project a potential 100% rally for Ethereum in 2026, others emphasize the necessity for ETH to surpass the $2,800 resistance level to confirm a sustained bullish trend.
title: Ethereum Whales Accumulate $322M ETH; Analyst Eyes $2800 Breakout
